person.p: the tag layer; a sentence written by the tagger about the paper, always anchored to a quotation but not itself a quotation

span.label: existence
span.quote: The most important observation to come out of studies such as these is that networks are generally very far from random.

span.label: structure and function of complex networks
span.quote: This paper reviews recent (and some not-so-recent) work on the structure and function of networked systems such as these.

span.label: review
span.quote: Here we review developments in this field, including such concepts as the small-world effect, degree distributions, clustering, network correlations, random graph models, models of network growth and preferential attachment, and dynamical processes taking place on networks.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: generative network models - random graphs and growth with preferential attachment - reproduce the observed structure of real networks (skewed degree distributions, small-world, clustering)
span.quote: models of network growth and preferential attachment

span.label: the crucial theoretical developments in the field remain open
span.quote: It remains to be seen what the crucial theoretical developments will be in this area.

span.label: The review acknowledges that the study of networks is incomplete and that only some of the described network variants are covered by the work it reviews.
span.quote: The study of networks is by no means a complete science yet, and many of the possibilities have yet to be explored in depth, but we will see examples of at least some of the variations described here in the work reviewed in this paper.

span.label: The field reviewed has no systematic programme for characterising network structure, so the measures surveyed may not be the important ones.
span.quote: We do not yet, as we do in some other fields, have a systematic program for characterizing network structure.

span.label: Little can be reported on the third aim of the field - the effect of structure on system behaviour - because that work is only beginning.
span.quote: Studies of the effects of structure on system behavior on the other hand are still in their infancy.

span.label: The review closes by stating that the whole subject it surveys is at an early stage.
span.quote: The study of complex networks is still in its infancy.
